scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "bun run --cwd apps/api dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "bun run --cwd apps/api start" "bun run --cwd apps/web start"
scripts.start:parity: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web,legacy --prefix-colors magenta,cyan,blue "bun run --cwd apps/api start" "bun run --cwd apps/web start -- --port 3201" "bun run legacy:preview"
scripts.build: bun run content:check && bun run --cwd apps/api build && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
scripts.check: bun run content:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:installer && bun run lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/content typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun test packages/content/src/content.test.ts apps/web/lib/assessment.test.ts apps/web/lib/automaticity-analysis.test.ts apps/web/lib/adaptive-daily-plan.test.ts apps/web/lib/pdf-reader-link.test.ts apps/web/lib/deepl-integration.test.ts && bun run --cwd apps/api test
